newsitem.title: USA: FLORIDA PROBING COLUMBIA ON MEDICAID.
newsitem.headline: FLORIDA PROBING COLUMBIA ON MEDICAID.

text.p: The Florida attorney general's office said Wednesday that it launched several months ago an investigation of possible Medicaid fraud involving Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp.

"We are conducting an investigation of Columbia ... to determine whether or not any of Columbia's facilities may have violated Medicaid fraud laws," said Mark Schlein, director of the state attorney general's Medicaid fraud control unit in Tallahassee.

The probe began "several months ago," he said, adding that the state is also assisting federal authorities in their massive investigation of Nashville, Tenn.-based Columbia, the largest U.S. for-profit hospital company.
Attorneys general in Texas and Alabama are also conducting separate probes of the company.
